newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takara Shuzo to stop sales of juice, recall product.
newsitem.headline: Takara Shuzo to stop sales of juice, recall product.

text.p: Takara Shuzo Co Ltd said on Thursday that it would stop selling some of its grape juice products due to defects, and it would also recall 110,000 cases of grape juice that have already being shipped.
Takara said in a statement that it would recall grape drinks sold under the brand name "Takara Surioroshi Budo".
The company found that about 55 cases made between September 10 and 25 by a subcontractor were defective, but decided to recall all 110,000 cases, Takara said.
One case has 24 cans, it said.
About 30,000 cases were believed to be already sold with the rest at wholesalers and retailers, Takara said.
The company had no comment on the possible impact of the recall on its earnings.
